name: academic
trans: When something is academic, it relates to schools and education.

name: access
trans: The manager was the only person with access to the password.
Access is the right to enter or use something.

name: achieve
trans: I was happy that I could achieve my goal.
To achieve something is to successfully do it after trying hard.

name: affect
trans: The student’s poor attitude affected the other students in the class.
To affect someone or something is to have an influence over them.

name: afford
trans: I’ve been saving my money so I can afford to buy a new bike.
To afford something means to have enough money to pay for it.

name: agriculture
trans: The farmer studied agriculture in college.
Agriculture is the growing of plants and raising of animals for food.

name: alternative
trans: Her first plan to make extra money seemed weak, so she chose an alternative.
An alternative is something that you can choose instead of your first choice.

name: appeal
trans: Sleeping all day appeals to me, but I have to go to school.
To appeal to someone is to be interesting or attractive.

name: approach
trans: The boy approached his school.
To approach something means to move close to it.

name: artificial
trans: The artificial Christmas tree was made of plastic.
If something is artificial, it was not made naturally but mimics something natural.

name: astronomy
trans: Harold loved looking at the stars, so he decided to study astronomy.
Astronomy is the study of the stars and planets.

name: atmosphere
trans: Scientists worry that harmful substances are hurting the atmosphere.
The atmosphere is the air around the Earth where weather conditions form.

name: attention
trans: His work got the attention of two of his co-workers.
Attention is the notice, thought, or consideration of someone.

name: attract
trans: The magnet attracted the metal.
To attract means to make a person or thing come closer or be interested.

name: lure
trans: The store lures people in with big signs that say “Sale!”
To lure someone is to convince them to do something by using a trick.

name: avoid
trans: Avoid the broken bottle on the floor.
To avoid something is to stay away from it.

name: aware
trans: The student became aware that the teacher was watching him.
If someone is aware, they know that something or a situation exists.

name: boom
trans: The firecrackers made a loud boom when they exploded.
To boom means to make a loud, deep sound.

name: population
trans: The population of our city is steadily growing.
A population is all the people living in an area.

name: balance
trans: A good balance between work and fun helps keep you healthy.
Balance is when two or more things are equal.

name: beforehand
trans: He packed his luggage beforehand, so he was able to leave right away.
If something is done beforehand, then it is done in advance.

name: biological
trans: In science class, we learned about the biological process of bacterial growth.
Biological describes the process of life and living things.

name: biology
trans: We learned about the human heart in biology class.
Biology is the study of living things.

name: borrow
trans: Can I borrow a pencil to use today? I’ll give it back to you tomorrow.
To borrow something is to take it and then give it back later.

name: boundary
trans: This fence shows the boundary between our yard and yours.
A boundary is the line where one area of land stops and another begins.

name: bounds
trans: If your ball lands outside the lines, it’s out of bounds.
Bounds is the area in a game in which plays are legal.

name: brain
trans: You must use your brain to solve the problem.
The brain is the organ in your head that lets you think.

name: breadth
trans: The breadth of the northern wall of the house is twenty meters.
Breadth is the distance from one side to the other side of something.

name: bright
trans: The bright light from the explosion hurt my eyes.
If something is bright, it gives off a lot of light.

name: broad
trans: The river is very long and broad.
Broad means that something is wide, not narrow.

name: busy
trans: Everyone is busy at the office today.
A busy person has a lot of things to do.

name: capacity
trans: The parking lot has reached its full capacity.
The capacity of something is the amount of things that can be put in it.

name: flow
trans: The water flowed over the rocks and into the lake.
To flow is to move easily and continuously in one direction.

name: cell
trans: A red blood cell carries oxygen.
A cell is the smallest part of a living thing that can live by itself.

name: certain
trans: I am certain that zebras have stripes.
If you are certain about something, you know it is true.

name: chemistry
trans: In chemistry class, the professor taught us about chemical reactions.
Chemistry is the study of substances and reactions between them.

name: cognitive
trans: After her physical examination, her cognitive skills were tested.
If something is cognitive, it is related to learning and knowing things.

name: combine
trans: Mina combined peanut butter and jelly to make a sandwich.
To combine is to join together to make a single thing or group.

name: command
trans: Joe gave the students a command to stand up.
A command is an order given to a person or animal to do something.

name: communicate
trans: He was unable to communicate his feelings clearly.
When we communicate with others, we talk or write to them.

name: concentrate
trans: I could not concentrate on my homework because the room was so loud.
To concentrate is to give one’s full attention to something.

name: concept
trans: I learned some concepts about molecules before working in the science lab.
A concept is an idea about something.

name: concern
trans: I was filled with concern after reading the newspaper.
Concern is a feeling of worry.

name: confident
trans: She was confident she could climb the mountain due to her training.
Confident people believe that they can do something without failing.

name: consistent
trans: Sara comes in every day and is our most consistent worker.
If a person is consistent, they always have the same behavior or attitude.

name: constitution
trans: The country’s constitution said a prime minister could only serve three terms.
A constitution is a document of principles for a government.

name: crisis
trans: The crisis was over and things returned to normal.
A crisis is a difficult time when things are going to either get worse or better.

name: criticize
trans: He criticized his wife for spending too much money.
To criticize is to say bad things about someone or something.

name: crust
trans: The little boy never ate the crust of his pizza.
Crust is the tough outer part of a loaf of bread.

name: cultivate
trans: A research company is cultivating new kinds of rice to aid poor countries.
To cultivate plants is to care for them and help them grow.

name: damage
trans: The car was damaged in the accident.
To damage something is to break it.

name: decline
trans: She declined his offer to pay for her dinner.
To decline an offer or invitation means to say no to it.

name: deliver
trans: The man delivered Chinese food to my house.
To deliver something is to take it from one place to another.

name: desert
trans: Not many plants grow in the desert.
The desert is an area of land without many plants or water.

name: desire
trans: My sister desires a big house and lots of money.
To desire is to want something.

name: destination
trans: The destination of this plane is Munich, Germany.
A destination is the place where someone or something is going.

name: destiny
trans: It was his destiny to become a great singer.
A destiny is all the things that happen or will happen to a person in their life.

name: direct
trans: The green path is a direct route to my house.
If something is direct, it goes straight between two places.

name: diversity
trans: My company puts an emphasis on the importance on having cultural diversity.
Diversity is the quality or state of having many different forms, types, ideas, etc.

name: double
trans: I paid almost double the amount for that shirt.
Double means twice as much or twice as many.

name: drop
trans: A small amount of water dropped from the bottle.
To drop is to fall or allow something to fall.

name: economy
trans: The factory was good for the economy because it brought jobs to the area.
An economy is the money and businesses of a country or region.

name: efficient
trans: My car is very efficient. I rarely have to buy gas.
If something or someone is efficient, they do not waste energy.

name: emotion
trans: Anger is a common emotion that we all feel.
An emotion is how you feel.

name: encounter
trans: I encountered a sea turtle while I was swimming.
To encounter is to find or meet a person or thing.

name: encourage
trans: My football coach will encourage us when we are losing.
To encourage people is to make them want to do something.

name: engage
trans: Dad was engaged in sawing a piece of wood in half.
To engage in something means to do it.

name: enjoy
trans: The woman enjoys riding her bicycle.
To enjoy is to like something.

name: enterprise
trans: My father owns an advertising enterprise.
An enterprise is a company or business.

name: enthusiastic
trans: The man was enthusiastic about his job.
An enthusiastic person is excited by or interested in something.

name: environment
trans: Keeping our environment clean is important to our health.
The environment is the place where people work or live.

name: era
trans: During the medieval era, knights wore protective armor.
An era is a period of time that has something special about it.

name: erosion
trans: Canyons are formed because rivers of fast-moving water caused erosion.
Erosion is the destruction of rock or soil due to flowing water or weather.

name: essay
trans: She had to write a two-page essay for her English class.
An essay is a short piece of writing on a certain subject.

name: essential
trans: It is essential to have oxygen when you scuba dive.
If something is essential, it is very important and necessary.

name: convention
trans: In the US, a popular convention is to shake hands when you meet someone.
A convention is behavior that is considered to be common or polite.

name: eventually
trans: He will eventually move to London to find a new job.
When something happens at a later time or in the end, it happens eventually.

name: evidence
trans: He used the pictures as evidence that UFOs are real.
Evidence is a fact or thing that you use to prove something.

name: executive
trans: After twenty years at the company, he finally became the executive.
An executive is the top manager of a business.

name: expensive
trans: My friend drives an expensive sports car.
Expensive things cost a lot of money.

name: experience
trans: Going to the concert was the best thing I’ve ever experienced.
To experience is to do or see something or have something happen to you.

name: explore
trans: He wants to explore the world and see new things.
To explore is to look for new places.

name: external
trans: It is warm inside my house, but the external temperature is freezing.
When something is external, it is connected to an outer part.

name: extraordinary
trans: The fireman who rescued the girl was extraordinary.
Extraordinary things are amazing.

name: famous
trans: The Eiffel Tower in Paris is very famous.
A famous person or thing is well known.

name: feature
trans: The cell phone has many features.
A feature is an important part of something.

name: fiber
trans: The mat was made from tiny fibers.
A fiber is a thread of a substance used to make clothes or rope.

name: firm
trans: He sleeps better on a firm bed.
A firm thing is solid but not too hard.

name: focus
trans: My mom always helps me to focus on my school work.
To focus on something is to think about it and pay attention to it.

name: foreign
trans: He has travelled widely in foreign countries.
Something foreign is something we are not used to.

name: fossil
trans: The expert arranged the fossils to build the skeleton of the dinosaur.
A fossil is the hard remains of a prehistoric animal or plant.

name: frequent
trans: While Dad was sick, the doctor made frequent visits to his house.
If something is frequent, then it happens or is done often.

name: fuel
trans: Wood is the fuel that burns to make heat in this fire.
Fuel is something that creates heat or energy.

name: fundamental
trans: The fundamental rules of basketball are easy.
If something is fundamental, it is a basic part of something.

name: gender
trans: Do you know the gender of her new baby?
Gender is a category that describes being either a boy or a girl.

name: generate
trans: The mayor promised to generate new jobs and programs to help the poor.
To generate something means to cause it to develop or begin.

name: genetic
trans: The color of one’s eyes is genetic.
If something is genetic, it is related to the genes in one’s body.

name: genius
trans: Since she was a genius, she easily passed all of her school exams.
A genius is a very smart person.

name: global
trans: Pollution is a global problem.
If something is global, it happens all around the world.

name: gravity
trans: There is no gravity in space.
Gravity is the force that makes things fall to Earth.

name: health
trans: People who want good health should not smoke.
Health is the state of a person’s body.

name: hire
trans: We hired a man to paint our house.
To hire someone is to pay that person money to work for you.

name: household
trans: Our household is made up of my father, my mother, and me.
A household is all the people who live in one house.

name: identical
trans: James and John are identical twins.
To be identical is to be the same as someone or something else.

name: identify
trans: I used the file to identify his name.
To identify something is to find out what it is.

name: improve
trans: He studied hard to improve his test scores from the previous year.
To improve something means to make it better.

name: income
trans: She was saving her income to buy a house.
An income is the money you earned from work.

name: innovation
trans: Mrs. Johnson made a great innovation to the company’s business plan.
An innovation is a product, or an idea, that is new or very original.

name: instant
trans: A microwave oven cooks food in an instant.
An instant is a very short amount of time.

name: intelligence
trans: Because of his high intelligence, he finished school early.
Intelligence is the ability to learn and understand things.

name: intense
trans: The skunk made an intense odor that filled the air.
An intense thing is very strong.

name: interpret
trans: It is difficult to interpret while someone is speaking.
When you interpret something, you find its meaning, often by changing it into a different language.

name: journalism
trans: Before becoming a teacher, she worked in journalism.
Journalism is the work of collecting the news to put in newspapers or on TV.

name: lack
trans: His only problem is a lack of money.
If there is a lack of something, there is not enough of it.

name: language
trans: The reporter spoke a language Sally had never heard before.
A language is a system of communication.

name: law
trans: The students learned about different laws during social studies class.
A law is a rule made by the legislative body.

name: layer
trans: There was a layer of snow on the tops of the houses this morning.
A layer covers over something or is one of several pieces lying on top of each other.

name: life
trans: My grandfather had a long life.
Life is the time when a person is alive.

name: line
trans: This is the longest line I have ever seen.
A line is a row of people or things.

name: literature
trans: Early American literature covers the poetry and stories from 1500 to 1800.
Literature is books, plays, and poetry.

name: management
trans: Practicing yoga is good for stress management.
Management is the act or process of controlling and dealing with something.

name: market
trans: I go to the market every weekend to buy vegetables.
A market is a place where people buy and sell products or food.

name: economy
trans: The factory was good for the economy because it brought jobs to the area.
An economy is the money and businesses of a country or region.

name: medical
trans: Tyler is a medical student studying to become a doctor.
Medical means related to the treatment of an injury or disease.

name: medication
trans: The doctor gave me medication to treat my illness.
Medication is medicine or drugs given to people who are sick.

name: mental
trans: I made a mental picture of the room.
If something is mental, it has to do with your mind.

name: metabolism
trans: If you exercise every day, your metabolism speeds up.
A person’s metabolism is the way chemical processes in their body use energy.

name: military
trans: I joined the military after I finished high school.
The military is the armed forces of a country.

name: molecule
trans: A tiny drop of water is made up of many billions of molecules of water.
A molecule is the smallest basic unit that makes up a physical substance.

name: monitor
trans: The teacher monitors the students when they take tests.
To monitor people or things is to watch them closely.

name: moral
trans: At the end of the story, the mother explained the moral to her children.
A moral is a message at the end of a story that teaches you something.

name: mortgage
trans: When they bought their new home, the married couple had to sign a mortgage.
A mortgage is a loan for property, especially a home or a business.

name: multicultural
trans: Everyone was welcome to attend the multicultural celebration.
When something is multicultural, it relates to many different cultures.

name: destination
trans: The destination of this plane is Munich, Germany.
A destination is the place where someone or something is going.

name: museum
trans: The Louvre is a famous museum in France.
A museum is a building that displays cultural, social, and scientific objects.

name: natural
trans: We need to take care of the natural world.
Things that are natural are not made by people.

name: nature
trans: On the weekends, I love to walk in nature among the trees.
Nature is everything in the physical world that is not made by people.

name: necessity
trans: Fresh water is a necessity for life.
A necessity is something that is needed.

name: network
trans: Lesley is part of a volunteer network that plants trees in the city.
A network is a group of people or organizations that are in some way connected to each other.

name: nevertheless
trans: He is usually friendly. Nevertheless, he wasn’t friendly this afternoon.
Nevertheless shows a difference to what is expected or known.

name: normal
trans: It is normal to wear school uniforms in private schools.
A normal thing is usual and not strange.

name: novel
trans: He wrote a great novel about ancient China.
A novel is a book that tells a story.

name: nowadays
trans: Nowadays, not so many people smoke.
Nowadays means at the present time.

name: objective
trans: My objective this week is to finish my homework by 7:30 every night.
An objective is a goal or plan that someone has.

name: obvious
trans: It was obvious that he was tired. He kept falling asleep.
Obvious means clear or easy to see.

name: official
trans: Her official degree was being transferred.
An official thing is approved by someone in authority.

name: operate
trans: I’m sorry, but the trains are not operating today.
To operate means to work or function.

name: ordinary
trans: Today was just an ordinary day. Nothing unusual happened.
Ordinary means normal, or not special in any way.

name: organism
trans: We studied the organism under the microscope.
An organism is a living thing, especially a very small one.

name: original
trans: This is the original painting of the Mona Lisa.
If something is original, it is the first one of that thing.

name: originally
trans: This building was originally a bank.
Originally is used in place of “in the beginning” or “when something first happened or began.”

name: output
trans: The boss hired more workers to increase the factory’s output of products.
Output is the amount of something that a person or thing produces.

name: overseas
trans: John often goes overseas for vacations.
Overseas shows an action happens in another country, across an ocean.

name: pain
trans: His head was full of pain.
Pain is the feeling that you have when you are hurt.

name: panic
trans: Everyone panicked when the house caught on fire.
To panic is to feel so nervous or afraid that one cannot think clearly.

name: participate
trans: The students participated in the school play.
To participate is to be active and do something.

name: particular
trans: The dress shop didn’t have the particular dress she was looking for.
If something is particular, then it is a single, important part of a group of things.

name: patient
trans: I had to be patient and wait until 5 o’clock to leave.
If people are patient, they don’t become angry or upset easily.

name: perform
trans: He will perform a song for the class.
To perform is to do something in front of people who watch.

name: performance
trans: Liam’s performance in the race was not his best.
Performance is how well someone or something functions, works, etc.

name: period
trans: In one period in Europe, there were many knights.
A period is an amount of time when something happens.

name: pile
trans: The pile of cups was beginning to lean.
A pile is a large group of things on top of one another.

name: plane
trans: They took a plane across the ocean to India.
A plane is a vehicle that has an engine and wings and flies in the air.

name: planet
trans: Saturn is the planet with the ring around it.
A planet is a large round thing in space.

name: poor
trans: The condition of the sidewalk is very poor.
When something is poor, it is not as good as it could or should be.

name: population
trans: The population of our city is steadily growing.
A population is all the people living in an area.

name: positive
trans: She has a positive future ahead of her after finishing college.
If something is positive, it is good.

name: negative
trans: She doesn’t like to say negative things about her friends.
When something is negative, it is unpleasant or sad.

name: potential
trans: I’ve thought of some potential problems with your idea.
Potential means capable of being but not yet actual or real.

name: powerful
trans: This perfume has a powerful scent.
If something is powerful, it has a strong effect.

name: premium
trans: Tony paid a premium for the gas because it made his car run better.
A premium is a payment that is higher than average.

name: primary
trans: His primary thoughts are about money.
If something is primary, it is the most important thing.

name: primitive
trans: The computers of the 1980s are primitive compared to those of today.
If something is primitive, then it is simple, basic, and not very developed.

name: principle
trans: To maintain principles, it’s vital to watch, listen, and speak carefully.
A principle is a belief about the correct way to behave.

name: produce
trans: This tree produces apples every year.
To produce something is to make or grow it.

name: professor
trans: Mike’s science professor knows a lot about physics.
A professor is a person who teaches in college.

name: profound
trans: For a young man, Jeremy has some profound thoughts.
Profound means deep or very intelligent.

name: protein
trans: Fish and beef are good sources of protein.
Protein is a substance that is necessary for the body to grow and be strong.

name: publish
trans: That company publishes daily newspapers.
To publish a book is to get it printed and ready to sell.

name: purpose
trans: The purpose of exercising is to get into shape.
A purpose is the reason that you do something.

name: reject
trans: I’m afraid the teacher will reject my new idea.
To reject is to refuse to accept, believe in, or agree with something.

name: release
trans: She released the bird from her hands.
To release something is to stop holding it.

name: remove
trans: I removed the nail from the board.
To remove something is to take it away.

name: require
trans: We require teachers to have a university degree.
To require something is to say that it is necessary.

name: research
trans: Scientists did a lot of research on the subject of blood type.
Research is close and careful study to discover new things.

name: resource
trans: The poor man didn’t have the resources to feed himself.
Resources are a person’s or country’s money and materials that they can use.

name: rest
trans: I rested on the couch after work.
To rest is to stop being active while the body gets back its strength.

name: rock
trans: I stacked rocks on top of one another.
A rock is a hard thing in the dirt.

name: rupture
trans: Sarah put too much water into the balloon, and it ruptured.
To rupture means to tear or burst open.

name: safety
trans: For his own safety, he was placed in a car seat.
Safety means the condition of being safe and free from danger.

name: scale
trans: I was surprised by the scale of the buildings in the downtown area.
The scale of something is its size, especially when it is very large.

name: several
trans: He had to read several books for class.
Several is more than two but not many.

name: shortage
trans: During the dry season, there was a shortage of water.
Shortage comes from short and means not having enough.

name: similar
trans: I have had a similar experience to the one you described.
Things which are similar are almost the same.

name: solar
trans: Using solar energy is good for the environment.
If something is solar, it is related to the sun.

name: sophisticated
trans: Jake is one of the most sophisticated people I’ve ever met.
If someone is sophisticated, they know many things about the world.

name: source
trans: The river was the source of drinking water for the village.
A source of something is the place that it comes from.

name: species
trans: There are 21 different species of butterfly in this forest.
A species is a type of plant or animal.

name: staff
trans: My dad has a staff of four people to help him at the office.
A staff is a group of people working together in a company.

name: state
trans: The president stated his opinion about the world’s health concerns.
To state something means to say it in a definite way.

name: strategy
trans: The team came up with a strategy to win the game.
A strategy is a plan for how to do something.

name: stress
trans: Dan has a lot of stress at work.
Stress is a strong feeling of worry caused by problems in life, work, etc.

name: structure
trans: There are big differences in family structure in different cultures.
The structure involves the shape and organization of the parts of a building or group.

name: substantial
trans: The bank said that he owed it a substantial amount of money.
If something is substantial, then it is of great importance, size, or value.

name: suffer
trans: Her headache made her suffer all day.
To suffer is to feel pain.

name: supply
trans: The water heater supplied the house with warm water.
To supply something means to give people what they need or want.

name: support
trans: Everyone at work supports the new plan.
To support something is to like it and help it be successful.

name: surface
trans: She wiped the surface of the table.
The surface is the top layer of something.

name: suspicious
trans: Dad was suspicious of the caller on the line.
A suspicious person does not trust others, or is not trusted by others.

name: talent
trans: Maria has a talent for playing the piano.
A talent is a natural ability to do something well.

name: technology
trans: He loves technology such as laptop computers.
Technology is new things made by using science.

name: term
trans: I often use the term “oops” when I make a mistake.
A term is a word for something.

name: textile
trans: The blue textile was going to be used to make blouses.
Textile is cloth that has been woven or knitted.

name: great
trans: It was a great, exciting game!
When something is great, it is very good.

name: depression
trans: Ron decided to get help for his depression.
Depression is a medical condition that makes a person very unhappy for long periods of time.

name: revolution
trans: The revolution in Russia led to the creation of the Soviet Union.
A revolution is a change to the political system by a group of people.

name: management
trans: Practicing yoga is good for stress management.
Management is the act or process of controlling and dealing with something.

name: totally
trans: I am totally against that.
If you totally agree, you agree with everything just said.

name: traditional
trans: I prefer traditional furniture.
When something is traditional, it is based on old-fashioned ideas.

name: transfer
trans: The family transferred the groceries from the shopping cart to the car.
To transfer something means to move it from one place to another.

name: transportation
trans: I don’t have a car, so my normal transportation is the train.
Transportation is any type of vehicle that can carry people or things.

name: unique
trans: Her dog is unique. I’ve never seen one quite like it.
A unique person or thing is not like others.

name: utility
trans: If you don’t pay the utilities, you may have your electricity turned off.
A utility is a business that supplies services such as water or electricity.

name: value
trans: Your love for me has greater value than gold.
The value of something is what it is worth.

name: variety
trans: There are a variety of flowers at the shop.
A variety of something is a group of many different kinds of it.

name: various
trans: She owned shoes of various styles.
If something is various, there are many types of it.

name: version
trans: She read the students British version of the Chinese fairy tale.
A version is an account of something that differs slightly from the original.

name: village
trans: There are only a few houses in my village.
A village is a very small town.

name: vital
trans: The heart is a vital organ.
Something vital is necessary for life.

name: volume
trans: The volume of cars in the parking lot was steadily increasing.
The volume is the total amount of something.

name: wealth
trans: One of the most important things for some people is wealth.
Wealth is the total of one’s possessions (money, land, etc.).

name: web
trans: Mom cleaned the spider webs out of the garage.
A web is a home made by a spider.
